Google.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
Google.description: Flagship multimodal model (May 19, 2026) now default across Gemini app, AI Mode in Search, and Gemini Enterprise. 1M context, 4x faster than other frontier models, native to Antigravity 2.0 agentic dev platform. Gemini 3.5 Pro expected this month.

Amazon.name: Nova 2
Amazon.description: Amazon's Nova model family for complex reasoning, agentic workflows, and multimodal tasks. Nova 2 offers improved instruction following and lower latency via Bedrock.

OpenAI.name: GPT-5.5
OpenAI.description: Frontier reasoning model (April 23, 2026), GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro in API (April 24). GPT-5.5 Instant default in ChatGPT since June 3, 2026. Powers Codex (including Codex Mobile preview May 14, 2026), Deep Research, voice, image, agent tools. GPT-5.6 'kindle-alpha' checkpoint surfacing in Codex logs; Polymarket prices June 30 release at 80-89%.

Anthropic.name: Claude Fable 5
Anthropic.description: Anthropic's first Mythos-class generally available model (June 9, 2026) at $10/$50 per 1M tokens. SOTA on SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%, FrontierCode 29.3%, OSWorld 83.4%, Humanity's Last Exam 49.8% (57.9% w/ tools). 1M context, 128K output, adaptive thinking, vision. Falls back to Opus 4.8 for cyber/biology/chemistry/distillation. Claude Mythos 5 available to Project Glasswing. SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US government export control directive over alleged narrow jailbreak — disabled for all customers worldwide pending review. Claude Opus 4.8 (May 28, 2026) at $5/$25 remains the default Claude surface.

xAI.name: Grok 4.3
xAI.description: xAI frontier model (April 17, 2026, API May 6) with 1M context, $1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens. grok-4.20 extends to 2M context. Custom Voices TTS ($4.20/1M chars), Voice Agent API ($3/hr). grok-imagine-image-quality for image generation. Grok 5 in training on Colossus 2 (1.5GW), Polymarket prices June 30 release at ~7%.

ByteDance.name: Doubao 2.0
ByteDance.description: ByteDance multimodal model family behind Doubao experiences. Seed 2.0 Pro/Lite/Mini powers Doubao App and TRAE. Seed 2.0 Lite (April 28, 2026) is first omni-modal understanding model with cross-modal audio+video reasoning. 345M MAU as of March 2026.

Oracle.name: OCI Generative AI
Oracle.description: Oracle's fully managed generative AI service for enterprise applications with REST APIs and SDKs. Summarization, writing assistance, and chat built into Oracle Cloud.

Cohere.name: Command A+
Cohere.description: Cohere's open-source 218B-parameter MoE model (May 21, 2026) with 25B active, Apache 2.0 license. Unified across reasoning, vision, translation, and tool use. Runs on 2x H100 or a single Blackwell GPU. +20% agentic QA, +32% spreadsheet analysis vs Command A Reasoning. 85% on τ²-Bench Telecom. Powers North enterprise workspace.

Moonshot.name: Kimi K2.6
Moonshot.description: Moonshot's open-source agent-first model (April 20, 2026, K2.6: 1T total/32B active MoE, 256K context) optimized for coding, agent swarms, and OpenClaw/Hermes workflows. Generates full-stack sites with video hero sections and motion design from a single prompt. K2.6 Agent Swarm runs up to 300 sub-agents, 4,000 coordinated steps. K2.7-Code (June 12, 2026, 1T/32B, Modified MIT, $0.95/$4.00) is the coding-specialized variant: +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2 vs K2.6, 30% fewer reasoning tokens, 256K context. Powers Kimi chat, Kimi Work (local desktop), and Kimi Code. Matches/beats frontier models on coding/agentic benchmarks.

Baidu.name: ERNIE 5.1
Baidu.description: Baidu's flagship model (May 8, 2026) trained at 6% of comparable pre-training cost. 1,223 score on LMArena Search Arena (#4 global, #1 Chinese). Topped domestic search rankings; strong τ³-bench and SpreadsheetBench-Verified. Powers ernie.baidu.com chat and Qianfan model platform.

Meta.name: Muse Spark
Meta.description: Meta's latest flagship model (April 8, 2026), ranks 4th on AI Index with strong health and science reasoning. Multimodal with tool-use and Contemplating mode for multi-agent reasoning.

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek V4
DeepSeek.description: Open-model MoE family (V4-Pro: 1.6T total / 49B active, V4-Flash: 284B / 13B active, April 24, 2026) with 1M context, Apache 2.0 licensed. 27% of per-token inference FLOPs vs V3. V4-Pro: $0.435/$0.87, V4-Flash: $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens (cache hit from $0.0028/$0.003625). Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner retire Jul 24, 2026.

Mistral.name: Medium 3.5
Mistral.description: Mistral's unified 128B dense model (April 28, 2026) replaces Medium 3.1, Magistral, and Devstral 2. 256K context, 77.6% SWE-Bench Verified, open weights under Modified MIT. Default in Le Chat and Vibe CLI (May 5, 2026).

Alibaba.name: Qwen 3.7-Max
Alibaba.description: Alibaba's new flagship model (May 26, 2026, Singapore Qwen Conference) with 1T+ parameters, 1M context, runs 35 hours autonomously without performance degradation. Top-tier on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Powers Wukong enterprise platform, Qwen App with full Taobao integration, and Qwen Cloud agentic platform. Qwen3.6-Plus also available.

Microsoft.name: MAI-Thinking-1
Microsoft.description: Microsoft AI's first in-house reasoning model (June 2, 2026, Build) with 35B active / ~1T total MoE params, 256K context, no third-party distillation. Matches Sonnet 4.6 in blind side-by-side, competitive with Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro coding. In private preview on Microsoft Foundry, will move to MAI Playground public preview. Also available on Fireworks AI, Baseten, Open Router.

Google.name: Gemma 4
Google.description: Google's open model family (April 2, 2026) for lightweight multimodal deployment. Gemma 4 Assistant enables speculative decoding for Gemma 4 models. Apache 2.0 license.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax M3
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's flagship open-weight model (May 31, 2026) with 1M-token context, native multimodality (image+video input, desktop computer use), and frontier coding/agentic performance. 59.0% SWE-Bench Pro, 83.5 BrowseComp, 70.06% OSWorld-Verified. Powered by MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) — 9x prefill, 15x decode speedup at 1M context, 1/20th per-token compute. Token Plan $20/$50/$120/mo. Open weights shipping within 10 days of release.

Nous Research.name: Hermes 3
Nous Research.description: Nous Research's open-weight instruction-tuned model series, evolving into the Hermes Agent (189K GitHub stars, MIT, v0.16.0 'The Surface Release' June 6, 2026). 40+ tools, MCP integration, persistent memory, scheduled tasks, messaging gateway across Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp/Signal. Optimized for local agentic workflows on NVIDIA RTX PCs and DGX Spark with Qwen 3.6, Llama, Mistral via Ollama or LM Studio.

NVIDIA.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra
NVIDIA.description: NVIDIA's 550B total / 55B active LatentMoE (Mamba-2 + MoE + Attention hybrid) with Multi-Token Prediction, released June 4, 2026 under OpenMDW-1.1. 1M context, NVFP4 quantization runs on Hopper/Blackwell/Ampere, 5x faster inference vs other open models, 30% lower cost to task completion on Terminal Bench 2. 20T pretraining tokens. Packaged as NIM microservice with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.

Google.name: Gemini Spark
Google.description: 24/7 personal AI agent powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash (May 19, 2026). Now with Notebooks for project organization, sync with NotebookLM. Deep Think and Deep Research Max modes available. Project Mariner capabilities folded into Gemini Agent. MacOS app integration announced for summer 2026.

OpenAI.name: ChatGPT
OpenAI.description: Powered by GPT-5.5 with GPT-5.5 Instant as default since June 3, 2026 (readability upgrade May 28). Personal Finance experience (May 15) for Pro users with Plaid. ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets GA (May 5). Voice intelligence updates May 7 with GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, GPT-Realtime-Whisper. Codex Mobile interface in ChatGPT iOS/Android (May 14, 2026).

Anthropic.name: Claude
Anthropic.description: Default on Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8 for max capability. Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class) SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive — disabled for all customers. Claude for Small Business (May 13) with Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign connectors. Claude Cowork GA (April 9) on macOS/Windows. Microsoft 365 add-ins for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook. Effort control across all plans. Anthropic-DXC alliance (June 11, 2026) and TCS partnership (June 12, 2026) for regulated industries.

Microsoft.name: Copilot
Microsoft.description: Powered by GPT-5.5 Instant (May 7, 2026) across web, work, and Microsoft 365 surfaces. Agent Platform, Agents SDK, and Copilot Studio for enterprise orchestration. MAI-Thinking-1 (June 2, 2026) available in private preview for in-house reasoning. Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 in GitHub Copilot. Microsoft Scout (June 2, 2026, Frontier preview) is the first Autopilot — always-on personal agent integrated into Teams/Outlook/OneDrive, built on OpenClaw. New Copilot superapp launch.

Meta.name: Meta AI
Meta.description: Powered by Muse Spark. Meta AI app rebuilt natively on May 12, 2026: Contemplating mode (multi-agent visible parallel reasoning), Live AI camera for real-time vision streaming, Marketplace shopping agent across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook. Free at meta.ai and across Meta apps, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, WhatsApp. Rolling out to Ray-Ban Meta glasses.

Amazon.name: Amazon Q
Amazon.description: Enterprise-first assistant grounded in AWS services and company data. Two tiers: Q Business for knowledge work, Q Developer for coding. Alexa for Shopping (May 13, 2026) replaces Rufus, integrates shopping capabilities into main Alexa experience.

xAI.name: Grok
xAI.description: Powered by Grok 4.3 with Connectors for web, iOS, Android. MCP server support. Custom Voices (Apr 30, 2026), $4.20 per 1M characters for TTS. Grok Skills (May 22, 2026) for persistent custom expertise, file/deck/spreadsheet/PDF generation. Grok Build early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers (May 14, 2026). Grok Business and Enterprise tiers. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) with skills/MCP/plugins from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. Gopuff Go agent (June 9, 2026) powered by Grok text/audio/image. eToro Tori (June 10, 2026) with real-time market sentiment from X. Grok Voice API default for Vapi (June 3, 2026).

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek Chat
DeepSeek.description: Powered by DeepSeek V4 with multimodal image recognition (April 29, 2026). Expert Mode (Pro) and Instant Mode (Flash) available. Optimized for Claude Code and OpenClaw. Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner retire Jul 24, 2026.

Mistral.name: Vibe
Mistral.description: Mistral's unified AI agent (rebranded from Le Chat, May 28, 2026) with Work Mode (long-running multi-step tasks with parallel tool calls, recurring scheduled jobs, 100+ connectors, MCP) and Code Mode (remote cloud coding sessions in isolated sandboxes, GitHub PR integration, Slack trigger). New VS Code extension and JetBrains/Zed ACP integration. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5. Pro $14.99/mo, Team $24.99/user/mo.

ByteDance.name: Doubao
ByteDance.description: Powered by Doubao 2.0 and Seed 2.0. 345M MAU (March 2026). Paid subscriptions launched May 4: Standard 68 yuan, Advanced 200 yuan, Professional 500 yuan.

Tencent.name: Yuanbao
Tencent.description: Powered by Hunyuan 3.0 (Hy3) MoE, 295B total params, 21B active, 256K context — fast-and-slow thinking fused. 9 legacy models (HY 2.0 Think, hunyuan-T1-latest, hunyuan-turbos, hunyuan-standard, hunyuan-role, etc.) retire June 26, 2026; multimodal vision models (HY Vision 1.5 Instruct, hunyuan-turbos-vision, hunyuan-t1-vision, hunyuan-turbos-vision-video) retire June 22, 2026. New multimodal lineup: HY-Vision-2.0-Instruct, HY-Vision-1.5-Thinking, HY-Vision-Video, YT-VITA on TokenHub. HunyuanVideo-Avatar open-sourced for voice-driven digital humans (May 28, 2026). API on TokenHub at $0.18/M input, $0.59/M output.

Alibaba.name: Qwen Chat
Alibaba.description: Powered by Qwen 3.7-Max (May 26, 2026) with 35-hour autonomous runs, multilingual chat, agentic coding, and advanced reasoning. Full Taobao integration (4B+ products) for agentic shopping. Shopping assistant with AI try-on. Compatible with Qoder coding platform.

HuggingFace.name: HuggingChat
HuggingFace.description: Multi-model open chat surface for Llama, Qwen, Mistral, and more. Inference API 3.0 with edge deployment, 10x latency improvements, offline inference.

Perplexity.name: Perplexity
Perplexity.description: Answer engine with GPT-5.5 orchestration. Personal Computer for Mac (May 11). Computer Agent with Workflows, Teams integration, Snowflake/Databricks connectors. Computer in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook (May 28, 2026); Teams integration from earlier in May. Harvard Business School study (June 10, 2026): Computer cuts estimated task time by 87% and cost by 94% across 10,000 matched pairs. Personal Computer with local inference (hybrid local-server orchestrator) coming in July 2026 — first product to treat compute as one more thing to orchestrate across machine and cloud.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax Agent
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's AI assistant powered by MiniMax M3 (June 1, 2026) with Agent Team building, MSA-powered 1M-context reasoning, habit learning, and all-in-one chat with skills, memories, and schedules. Desktop app available. Token Plan tiers $20/$50/$120/mo.

Cohere.name: Coral
Cohere.description: Cohere's enterprise chat assistant (May 2026) powered by Command A+. North workspace integration for grounded answers over enterprise data. Multi-session memory and agentic tool use. Free and Pro tiers.

Moonshot.name: Kimi
Moonshot.description: Moonshot's flagship AI assistant (May 2026) powered by Kimi K2.6 with K2.6 Agent Swarm (up to 300 sub-agents, 4,000 coordinated steps) and Kimi Claw cloud teammate. Long-context chat, web search, multimodal inputs, deep research, agent swarm workflows. Kimi Work (June 8/12 2026) is the local-first desktop variant — see Sovereign Agent. Free, Moderato $19/mo, Allegretto $39/mo, Allegro $99/mo.

Google.name: Gemini Code Assist
Google.description: IDE coding agent powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash, native to Android Studio, VS Code, JetBrains. Antigravity 2.0 released May 19, 2026 as agent-first dev platform with parallel sub-agents.

OpenAI.name: Codex
OpenAI.description: IDE extension and cloud coding agent powered by GPT-5.5. Available in VS Code, GitHub, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse, and the Codex CLI. Mobile preview inside ChatGPT iOS/Android (May 14, 2026) supervises Codex sessions on Mac. Safe coding commitment May 8, 2026. On AWS Bedrock (April 28, 2026). 5M+ weekly active users (June 2, 2026). Six role-specific enterprise plugins (data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, equity investing, investment banking) plus Annotations and Sites (June 2, 2026) for building/deploying internal web apps. Acquiring Ona (announced June 11, 2026) for secure customer-controlled cloud execution.

Anthropic.name: Claude Code
Anthropic.description: Terminal-first coding agent with IDE workflows powered by Claude Opus 4.8. Claude Fable 5 SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive — was available in GitHub Copilot, Claude API, and Claude Platform on AWS (June 9, 2026). Dynamic workflows GA in Claude Code (June 11, 2026, Code with Claude Tokyo) — Claude writes orchestration scripts running tens to hundreds of parallel subagents per session, enabled via /ultracode or asking Claude to create a workflow. Scheduled deployments and environment variable vaults in public beta in Claude Managed Agents (June 11, 2026). ant CLI, Claude Code Analytics API. /ultrareview, auto mode for Max users. Desktop app GA. Fast mode for Opus 4.8 at 2x standard rate for 2.5x speed.

Microsoft.name: GitHub Copilot
Microsoft.description: Editor-native agent mode with GPT-5.5, Claude (Opus 4.8, Fable 5 — suspended June 12, 2026 by US export control directive), and Gemini model options. Agent mode for multi-file changes, documentation generation, PR review. Fable 5 was GA in Copilot (June 9, 2026) for Pro+/Max/Business/Enterprise requiring 30-day data retention. MAI-Thinking-1 in private preview on Foundry with GitHub Copilot integration.

Amazon.name: Kiro
Amazon.description: AI IDE with spec-driven development. Structured AI coding that turns specifications into implementations. Autonomous agent mode for background task completion.

JetBrains.name: JetBrains Junie
JetBrains.description: JetBrains AI coding agent with Junie CLI in beta (March 9, 2026). LLM-agnostic supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Grok. MCP integration, IDE+CI/CD+GitHub/GitLab. Junie CLI Now Connects to Your JetBrains IDE (April 8, 2026). ACP Agent Registry. ReSharper 2026.2 EAP support.

Cursor.name: Cursor 3.7
Cursor.description: AI-native editor (Cursor 3 unified workspace since April 2, 2026). v3.3 (May 7) Build in Parallel async subagents and Split into PRs; v3.4 (May 13) multi-repo environments, Dockerfile build secrets, 70% faster layer-cached rebuilds; v3.5 (May 20) Automations to Agents Window with multi-repo/no-repo modes and Shared Canvases; v3.6 (May 29) Auto-review Run Mode with classifier subagent; v3.7 (June 4) Canvas Design Mode with multi-select and voice input, Context Usage Report, custom stores/tools, auto-review for SDK with subagent nesting. Auto-review now default for new users (June 11, 2026, cursor.com/blog/agent-autonomy-auto-review). Bugbot 3x faster/22% cheaper/10% more bugs (June 10), now runnable with /review. Composer 2.5 default. cursor.com/agents cloud URL. Pro cut 40% to $12/mo on June 12, 2026 with new Efficiency Mode (up to 35% token reduction); enterprise spend controls and usage-based tiers above thresholds. Pro+ $60/mo, Ultra $200/mo. Gartner Leader. Training much larger next-gen model with SpaceXAI on Colossus 2.

Cognition.name: Devin Desktop
Cognition.description: Cognition AI's agent-first IDE (formerly Windsurf, rebranded to Devin Desktop June 2, 2026). Windsurf 2.0 Agent Command Center with Kanban view of local + cloud agents, Codemaps, one-click Devin cloud handoff. SWE-1.5 free for 3 months, SWE-1.6 GA at 200 tok/s (Fireworks) / 950 tok/s (Cerebras). Devin Local 2026.5.26 in Rust, 30% more token-efficient than Cascade, subagent support, sandboxing. Devin 2.2 (May 21, 2026): end-to-end testing with computer use, Review Autofix, 3x faster startup, redesigned interface. Devin Auto-Triage (May 18, 2026): Devin proactively responds to bug reports/incidents, investigates with connected tools, opens PRs. ACP support for Codex, Claude Agent, OpenCode.

xAI.name: Grok Build
xAI.description: xAI coding agent and CLI (May 14, 2026) for SuperGrok/X Premium+ subscribers, in early beta. Plan mode for approve-before-execute workflows. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) bundles skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and LSPs into installable packages from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. /marketplace to browse. Parallel subagents, headless mode (-p) for scripting. ACP support for custom bots.

Microsoft-Code.name: MAI-Code-1-Flash
Microsoft-Code.description: Microsoft's inference-efficient coding model (June 2, 2026, Build) with 5B active parameters, 51% on SWE-Bench Pro, Haiku-class size but cheaper. Tuned for VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Microsoft stack. Rolling out as a default in VS Code for Copilot Free, Student, Pro, Pro+, and Max. First in a new wave of purpose-built coding models from Microsoft for GitHub Copilot.

Google.name: Gemini CLI
Google.description: Open terminal agent linked to Gemini Code Assist and Gemini model workflows. MCP protocol support.

OpenAI.name: Codex CLI
OpenAI.description: Terminal coding agent powered by GPT-5.5 and Codex. Cloud and local execution modes. Available on macOS (Windows host connection coming). Remote control from ChatGPT mobile (May 14, 2026).

Anthropic.name: Claude Code
Anthropic.description: Terminal-first coding agent with IDE workflows powered by Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Fable 5 SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive — was available via API). Dynamic workflows now GA (May 28, 2026 research preview → June 11, 2026 GA, Code with Claude Tokyo) for parallel sub-agents at scale. /ultracode or ask Claude to create a workflow. Scheduled deployments and env var vaults in public beta for Claude Managed Agents (June 11, 2026). ant CLI, Analytics API. /ultrareview, auto mode for Max users. Desktop app GA. v2.1.173 (June 11, 2026) normalizes Fable 5 model names with [1m] suffix.

xAI.name: Grok Build CLI
xAI.description: xAI terminal coding agent (May 14, 2026) for SuperGrok/X Premium+ subscribers, in early beta. Plan mode, parallel subagents, deep worktree integrations. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) for installing skills/MCP/plugins from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. ACP support for custom bots and orchestration. Headless mode for CI/CD. grok-build-0.1 API (May 29, 2026) at $1/$2 per 1M tokens, 100+ tok/s.

JetBrains.name: TeamCity CLI
JetBrains.description: Free, lightweight open-source CLI for TeamCity CI/CD. Enables AI agents to check build status, analyze failures, interact with Pipeline. MCP support for third-party AI tooling (May 12, 2026).

Courier.name: Courier CLI
Courier.description: Q2 2026 CLI for giving AI agents notification infrastructure and JSON-safe commands.

Amazon.name: Amazon Q CLI
Amazon.description: Command-line assistant for AWS operations, code changes, and shell workflows.

HuggingFace.name: Hugging Face CLI
HuggingFace.description: CLI for model, dataset, repo, and inference workflow management. v1.14.0 adds Space secrets/variables management.

Mistral.name: Mistral Vibe
Mistral.description: Open-source terminal-native coding agent powered by Mistral Medium 3.5. Remote cloud sandboxes via Vibe Code Workflow (May 5, 2026), parallel async sessions, GitHub PR integration. Le Chat rebranded to Vibe (May 28, 2026) — Work Mode and Code Mode under one agent and one license, all Le Chat history preserved. Vibe remote agents (May 22, 2026) can teleport local sessions to cloud when work outgrows laptop. Connectors in Studio with custom MCPs (May 22, 2026).

Zapier.name: Zapier Platform CLI
Zapier.description: CLI for building AI-enabled integrations, actions, and MCP-style tooling.

n8n.name: n8n CLI
n8n.description: CLI for workflow lifecycle, self-hosting, and automation operations.

NVIDIA.name: AI Workbench CLI
NVIDIA.description: CLI-backed local and remote AI dev environments for model teams.

Cognition.name: Devin CLI
Cognition.description: Cognition AI's local coding agent CLI (June 4, 2026) — run Devin right in your shell, with local/remote execution across Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and SWE-1.6. Custom terminal rendering in Rust for fast, snappy UI. Hand off long-running sessions to cloud agents with their own sandboxed computers when local isn't enough; resume in CLI or open PR. Install: `curl -fsSL https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh | bash`. ACP support for Codex, Claude Agent, OpenCode.

Google.name: Gemini API
Google.description: Developer platform for Gemini models, tools, embeddings, and multimodal apps. File Search now multimodal (May 5). Higher-res images, custom metadata. Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS in preview. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate audio model in public preview via Gemini Live API (June 9, 2026). Managed Agents API for autonomous agentic workflows (May 2026).

OpenAI.name: OpenAI Platform
OpenAI.description: Responses API with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro, GPT Image 2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0, April 21, 2026), Realtime 2 (gpt-realtime-2, gpt-realtime-translate, gpt-realtime-whisper May 7, 2026). Agent tooling, WebSocket execution mode. Batch and Flex pricing at half standard rate. Now on AWS Bedrock (June 1, 2026).

Anthropic.name: Claude API
Anthropic.description: Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class, June 9, 2026, $10/$50 per 1M tokens, 1M context) on `claude-fable-5` — SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive over alleged narrow jailbreak, disabled for all customers. Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5 remain available. Computer use, long-context developer platform, Advisor strategy, Memory, MCP tunnels, dreaming/outcomes/multiagent orchestration. Claude Platform on AWS GA (May 11, 2026). ant CLI for Claude API with YAML versioning and Claude Code integration (June 2026). Claude Code Analytics API. Dynamic workflows GA in Claude Code (June 11, 2026) and managed agents now run on schedules with vault-stored env vars (June 11, 2026).

Microsoft.name: Azure AI Foundry
Microsoft.description: Unified model, agent, eval, and deployment platform on Azure. Multi-model hub, inference profiles, global cross-region deployment. GPT-5.5 Instant, GPT-5.5 Thinking, and MAI-Thinking-1 (private preview, June 2, 2026) available. Fireworks AI GA on Foundry.

Amazon.name: Amazon Quick Suite
Amazon.description: AI agent teammates for research, business insights, and automation. Answer questions and turn answers into actions across enterprise workflows.

Meta.name: Llama API
Meta.description: Official API access path for Meta's Llama model ecosystem. Muse Spark API in private preview.

xAI.name: xAI API
xAI.description: Developer access to Grok 4.3 ($1.25/$2.50 per 1M tokens) and grok-4.20 (2M context). Custom Voices TTS ($4.20/1M chars), Voice Agent API ($3/hr). grok-imagine-image-quality for image generation. grok-build-0.1 for terminal coding workflows. Responses API with tool calling (May 22, 2026). Grok 5 in training on Colossus 2. Grok Build Plugin Marketplace (June 11, 2026) for skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and LSPs from MongoDB, Vercel, Sentry, Chrome DevTools, Cloudflare, Superpowers. Voice API default for Vapi (June 3, 2026). Gopuff Go and eToro Tori agent integrations.

DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek API
DeepSeek.description: Low-cost API access to DeepSeek V4 (Pro: $0.435/$0.87, Flash: $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens - 75% discount made permanent May 23, 2026). 1M context, 384K max output, reasoning modes, multimodal image recognition. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible formats. Hybrid Attention combining CSA and HCA. Built on Huawei Ascend 950PR.

Mistral.name: La Plateforme
Mistral.description: Mistral developer platform for chat, OCR, embeddings, agents, and code. Medium 3.5 default with reasoning_effort parameter. Vibe CLI with remote cloud sandboxes (May 5, 2026). Voxtral TTS with zero-shot voice cloning.

NVIDIA.name: NVIDIA Build
NVIDIA.description: NIM-backed API catalog and deployment platform for enterprise AI services. NIM 2.0 with custom model support. Nemotron 3 Ultra NIM 2.0.5 (June 4, 2026, 550B-A55B, NVFP4). NVIDIA Blackwell leads the first Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark (June 12, 2026). Cosmos, Isaac models available. Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 ASR, Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety on Microsoft Foundry (June 2, 2026).

Cloudflare.name: Workers AI
Cloudflare.description: Serverless GPU inference on Cloudflare's global network. 100+ open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Stable Diffusion, Whisper). 200+ cities, pay-per-use pricing, LoRA fine-tuning support.

Alibaba.name: Model Studio
Alibaba.description: Alibaba Cloud developer platform for Qwen models and agent apps. Qwen 3.7-Max (May 26, 2026, Singapore Qwen Conference) and Qwen3.7-Plus available via API. Qwen Cloud (June 3, 2026) is a new AI-native cloud platform with Skills portal for agents, CLI for workflows, and Model Studio CLI; brings together Qwen models, open-source models, and third-party offerings for text/vision/audio/image/video/embedding tasks.

HuggingFace.name: Inference API
HuggingFace.description: Hosted API layer for open models, endpoints, and serverless inference. Inference API 3.0 with edge deployment (10x latency), Inference Pro with auto-scaling.

MiniMax.name: MiniMax Platform

Cohere.name: Cohere API
Cohere.description: Developer platform for Command A+ (May 21, 2026, Apache 2.0) with embeddings, rerank, and agent toolkits. Self-host on 2x H100 or single Blackwell. North enterprise API with role-based access, audit logs, and data residency.

Moonshot.name: Moonshot API
Moonshot.description: Kimi K2.7-Code (June 12, 2026, Modified MIT, $0.95/$4.00 per 1M tokens, 1T total/32B active MoE, 256K context, +21.8% on Kimi Code Bench v2 vs K2.6) plus K2.6, K2.5 endpoints. OpenAI-compatible REST API with long-context, function calling, vision, and agent-mode tools. K2.7-Code targets long-horizon software engineering with 30% fewer reasoning tokens. Token-based pricing on Moonshot Platform.

Google.name: Vertex AI
Google.description: Managed training, serving, and agent deployment on Google Cloud. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for agent development. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite in preview.

Microsoft.name: Azure AI Foundry
Microsoft.description: Managed deployment, monitoring, and model routing on Azure. Supports models from OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, and more. MAI-Thinking-1 in private preview (June 2, 2026).

Amazon.name: SageMaker AI
Amazon.description: Managed model training, deployment, and MLOps workflows on AWS. Bedrock for inference, SageMaker for training. Claude Fable 5 was on Bedrock (June 9, 2026) in US East (N. Virginia) and Europe (Stockholm) — SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive.

Vera Rubin NVL72 systems ramped into full production (May 31, 2026) with 10x agent throughput vs Grace Blackwell. Nemotron 3 Ultra NIM 2.0.5 (June 4, 2026). NVIDIA Blackwell leads the first Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark (June 12, 2026). Hosted on build.nvidia.com.

NVIDIA-Vera.name: Vera CPU
NVIDIA-Vera.description: NVIDIA's first CPU built for agentic AI (launched March 16, 2026), ramping into full production as part of Vera Rubin NVL72 platform (May 31, 2026). 88 custom Olympus cores, Arm-compatible, 2x efficiency, 50% faster than traditional rack-scale CPUs. 1.8 TB/s NVLink-C2C coherent bandwidth pairs with Rubin GPUs. Deployed by Alibaba Cloud, ByteDance, Meta, Oracle Cloud, and NVIDIA Cloud Partners (CoreWeave, Crusoe, Lambda, Nebius, Nscale, Together AI).

HuggingFace.name: Inference Endpoints
HuggingFace.description: Dedicated hosting for open models with autoscaling and observability. Inference Pro API with serverless deployment.

vLLM.name: vLLM

Google.name: AI Studio

OpenAI.name: Playground
OpenAI.description: Prompt, eval, and tool testing workspace for GPT-5.5 and platform APIs. Responses API testing. Realtime voice model testing (gpt-realtime-2, May 7, 2026). GPT Image 2 playground for text/infographic/image-set generation.

JetBrains.name: AI Assistant
JetBrains.description: In-IDE assistant for completion, chat, refactors, and team model routing. Junie integration, ACP Agent Registry, BYOK support. TeamCity AI Assistant in Enterprise trial.

Cursor.name: Background Agent
Cursor.description: Async dev workflows for longer tasks inside the Cursor coding environment. Automations in Marketplace templates.

HuggingFace.name: Gradio
HuggingFace.description: UI toolkit for demos, eval apps, and internal AI developer tools. Diffusers 0.38.0 with new pipelines.

LangChain.name: LangSmith
LangChain.description: Tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and observability for agent stacks. LangGraph Platform for enterprise. LangSmith Engine (Interrupt 2026) watches production traces, clusters failures, diagnoses root causes, proposes fixes. LangSmith Sandboxes GA (May 13, 2026) — secure, kernel-isolated microVMs for agent code execution with parallel workloads, snapshotting, Service URLs, Sandbox CLI, Auth Proxy with custom callbacks. Deep Agents v0.6 with Delta Channels in langgraph v1.2 — checkpoint storage grows linearly instead of O(N²) for long message histories.

Kilo.name: Kilo Code
Kilo.description: Cloud coding agent with Mistral Medium 3.5, VS Code extension, CLI. Remote async sessions that open PRs on GitHub. Integrates with Tencent Hy3 preview.

HuggingFace-Serge.name: Serge
HuggingFace-Serge.description: HuggingFace's GitHub-native AI code reviewer (announced June 12, 2026, Apache 2.0). Reviews pull requests with any OpenAI-compatible LLM, follows repository-owned review rules in `.ai/review-rules.md`, and publishes inline comments through GitHub's review experience. Runs as a GitHub Action for single-repo CI, a GitHub App webhook for org-wide automation, or a staged web app for human-in-the-loop reviews. Compatible with OpenAI, the Hugging Face Router, local vLLM/TGI/LM Studio endpoints. Triggered with `@askserge please review`; bubblewrap sandboxing (June 9) isolates fork PR code from review host. Code at github.com/huggingface/serge.

Meta.name: AI Studio
Meta.description: Platform to create custom AI characters for entertainment, productivity, and support. Build conversational AIs with personality, knowledge, tone, and image generation. Share via Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp.

Google.name: Vertex AI Agent Builder
Google.description: Google orchestration layer for search, tools, and production agents. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Managed Agents API for autonomous Linux sandbox agents (May 2026).

OpenAI.name: Agent Platform
OpenAI.description: Agent Builder, Agents SDK, ChatKit, and eval tooling on GPT-5.5. WebSocket-based execution mode for lower latency.

Anthropic.name: Computer Use
Anthropic.description: Claude Opus 4.8 computer control and tool use for autonomous task execution. Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class) — SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive, disabled for all customers. MCP connector beta. Financial services agent templates for pitchbooks, KYC, month-end close.

Microsoft.name: Copilot Studio
Microsoft.description: Enterprise copilot orchestration for workflows, connectors, and approvals. GPT-5.5 Chat and GPT-5.5 Reasoning model options. MAI-Thinking-1 (June 2, 2026) and Claude Fable 5 (SUSPENDED June 12, 2026 by US export control directive) in Copilot.

Amazon.name: Bedrock AgentCore
Amazon.description: Agent development platform with managed harness, AgentCore CLI, and pre-built skills. Google.name: Imagen 4

OpenAI.name: GPT Image 2
OpenAI.description: Powered by ChatGPT Images 2.0 (gpt-image-2, April 21, 2026) — top-ranked on Image Arena. Thinkable generation mode, multilingual text rendering (Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali), 4K resolution, complex infographics and comic strips. Available in ChatGPT and the API; gpt-image-1.5 deprecated as default.

Microsoft.description: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.5 family (June 2, 2026, Build 2026) ranks #2 on Arena image edit leaderboard ahead of Nano Banana 2, with MAI-Image-2.5-Flash for high-volume workloads. Text-to-image and image-to-image with 'control with preservation' editing. Live in PowerPoint, rolling out to OneDrive, available in Foundry. MAI-Image-2.5: $5/$8 per 1M text/image input, $47 per 1M image output. MAI-Image-2.5-Flash: $1.75 per 1M text/image input, $19 per 1M image output. Also on OpenRouter.

Amazon.name: Titan Image
Amazon.description: Bedrock image model family for enterprise-safe generation and editing.

Adobe.description: Commercially safe image generation for creative and marketing workflows. Part of Adobe's agentic CX platform including Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator and CX Enterprise Coworker (April 20, 2026, GA coming months).

Midjourney.name: Midjourney
Midjourney.description: V8.1 became the default model on midjourney.com on June 10, 2026 after launching April 30, 2026 on Discord and web. Standard jobs now render 4-5x faster than earlier versions, sharper HD images, and improved prompt adherence. Moodboards and sref stable. V8.2 delayed to this month for aesthetic upgrade; V9 in development.

StabilityAI.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
StabilityAI.description: Stability AI's flagship open image model family (SD 3.5 Large 8.1B, Large Turbo, Medium 2.5B) plus API products Stable Image Ultra (powered by SD3.5 Large, $0.08/image) and Stable Image Core (next-gen after SDXL, $0.03/image). NVIDIA TensorRT-optimized SD 3.5 (June 12, 2026) — 2.3x faster generation on Large, 1.7x on Medium, 40% less VRAM, available on RTX 50/40 Series, Blackwell, Ada Lovelace RTX PRO. Available via Stability AI NIM, Hugging Face, and self-hosted.

BlackForest.name: FLUX.2
BlackForest.description: Black Forest Labs' current image model family. FLUX.2 [pro] production-grade at $0.03/MP with multi-reference (up to 10 images), 4MP output, exact hex color control, structured prompting. FLUX.2 [flex] for typography and fine-grained control. FLUX.2 [klein] 4B/9B open-weight models (Apache 2.0) with sub-0.5s inference on consumer GPUs since Jan 15, 2026 — first FLUX model shipping on consumer hardware via ASUS ProArt laptops with NVIDIA optimization (June 4, 2026). FLUX.2 [dev] 32B open-weight. Replaces FLUX.1 line. flux-2-pro-preview endpoint for speed upgrades, FLUX Erase (May 21, 2026) for mask-based object removal beating GPT Image-2, FLUX VTO (May 28, 2026) virtual try-on for retail catalog scale.

Reve.name: Reve 2.0
Reve.description: Reve AI's layout-first image model (June 3, 2026) — #2 on Text-to-Image Arena with 1280 score (+125 from 1.5), behind GPT Image 2 and ahead of Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2). Proprietary model from Palo Alto startup; ensemble approach. API access with layout-based creative control.

Google.name: Veo 3.1
Google.description: Google's flagship video generation model (Veo 3.1 updates shipped January 13, 2026) for cinematic and prompt-driven clips with native audio. Enhanced Ingredients to Video, native 9:16 vertical output, 4K upscaling, improved character/background consistency. Available in Gemini API, AI Studio, Vertex AI, Flow, YouTube Shorts, Google Vids.

Runway.description: Gen-4 video generation and editing suite for creators and teams. Aleph 2.0 with Edit Studio (May 21, 2026) edits 30s 1080p clips with frame propagation across cuts. Characters API for real-time conversational video agents (May 4, 2026). GWM-1 world model family.

Runway Characters.name: Runway Characters
Runway Characters.description: Character animation API for real-time conversational video agents. Part of Runway's Characters API platform (May 4, 2026). Powers Aleph 2.0 multi-shot handling.

MiniMax.name: Hailuo Video
MiniMax.description: MiniMax's video generation platform (Hailuo 2.3, May 31, 2026) with Media Agent. Enhanced dynamic expression, physical action, micro-expressions, motion commands. Same pricing as Hailuo 02. Hailuo 2.3 Fast at 50% lower cost. 1080p native, ranked top globally.

HeyGen.name: HeyGen
HeyGen.description: Avatar-first video generation with enterprise localization and dubbing flows. May 2026: Avatar V with Custom Motion (direct face/hands/posture/gaze/energy in plain English), Avatar V API ($0.05/second), LiveAvatar real-time conversational avatars, HyperFrames (turns HTML/agent markup into finished video), HyperFrames as official Claude connector (June 10, 2026). Native Android app. Integrations: Superhuman, Codex, Canva, Lovable (MCP/OAuth). $29/mo.

Pika 2.5 Studio timeline editor, Pikaffects 2.0 (Melt, Inflate, Explode, Squish, Cake-ify), Pikaswaps, Pikadditions, Pika MCP. 12s individual clips at 1080p. API via fal.ai, $0.05/second. Standard $8/mo, Pro $28/mo, Fancy $58/mo.

ByteDance.name: Seedance 2.0
ByteDance.description: ByteDance multimodal video generation with audio-video joint architecture. Up to 20-second clips via CapCut and Dreamina.

Luma.name: Ray3.2

Ray3.2 API now available for direct pipeline integration (June 9, 2026). Free tier, Pro $30/mo, Enterprise custom.

Meta.name: Meta Video Generation
Meta.description: Meta's video generation capabilities integrated across Meta apps.

Rolling out globally across all paid subscription tiers using the standard credit-based ecosystem.
